desc: Another trip out to the Stronghold, man a lot went into making this one... A brutal two hour hike up crazy steep trail, to discover a surreal vista. title: SACC Cochise Adopt-A-Crag 2015 1080
credit: "SACC Cochise Adopt-A-Crag 2015 1080" by Alex McIntyre (youtube.com/watch?v=-i6VyORMxsM), licensed CC BY
desc:
The Southern Arizona Climbers Coalition held their annual Cochise Stronghold Adopt-A-Crag event on September 26, 2015, in the East Stronghold. The objective: put in place erosion control techniques to fix and prevent further damage to the Rockfellow Group approach trail.

Assignment 3 (Sequences) for JOUR 307 - Multimedia.
